_meta.rule: Declared before the first evaluation run. Do not change after results are reported; add a revised value next to the original and explain it in the Testing wiki page.

core_recall.definition: Questions about a restricted ingredient in groups core_ingredient and multiple_restrictions whose risk probability is at or above the risk threshold, over those questions. A missed plain allergen is not acceptable.

hard_recall.definition: Same as core_recall for group hard_ingredient (DEPENDS_ON_PRODUCT and hidden sources). Lower on purpose: the model cannot see the product, and the deterministic catalog check covers these.

prose_recall.definition: Suggestion-text questions with text_risky true whose risk probability is at or above the risk threshold, over those questions.

false_rejection_rate.definition: Questions expected to be safe (safe ingredients in every case, and the text question when text_risky is false) whose risk probability is at or above the risk threshold, over those questions.

safe_case_pass.definition: Cases in groups safe and safe_negation in which no question reaches the risk threshold, over those cases.
